section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Perceived Sociocultural Influences on Body Image and Body Change Questionnaire (McCabe & Ricciardelli, 2001), a 62-item instrument assessing appearance pressures from multiple sources. For the current study, the questionnaire was adapted to 14 items, replacing parental questions with romantic partner questions, and assessing pressures from partner, friends, and media regarding weight loss, weight gain, and muscularity. Item scores were averaged to create composite measures of perceived appearance pressures from each source, with higher scores indicating greater perceived pressures.
